topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I can't believe this is happening. I just found out someone has tattooed one of my pieces on their body. Part of me feels honored, I guess, that they liked my work enough to put it on their skin. But another part is just... overwhelmed. I didn’t give permission. I don’t even know this person. What if they distort it, or it’s seen in the wrong context? I worked hard on that piece; it means a lot to me. I don’t know what to do. Should I reach out? What if they’re proud of it and don’t understand why I’m upset? My mind is racing, and I just don’t know where to start.
